title.purpose: Product card titles and section labels.

label.purpose: Buttons, badges, nav, field labels. Glossary noun form in ar.

price.purpose: EGP with tabular nums; currency after amount in ar.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, sheet enter. Image scale 1.03 on product cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Saffron CTA for add-to-cart and checkout. Noun-form labels.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C45C26; color: #FFFBF6; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9A4318; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C45C26; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #9A4318; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #1A1714; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid #E6DDD2; border-radius: 8px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F6F1EA; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C45C26; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Bone field, hairline, saffron focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #1A1714; } .ds-input { background: #FFFBF6; color: #1A1714; border: 1px solid #E6DDD2; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B645C; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C45C26; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #C45C26; }

components.name: Sale Chip
components.description: Only when a product is discounted.
components.css: .ds-chip-sale { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #B42318; color: #FFFBF6; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Signature unit: 4:5 photo, brand, title, tabular price, full-width add.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFBF6; color: #1A1714; border: 1px solid #E6DDD2; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: #F6F1EA; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-card-brand { margin: 0; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #6B645C; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card-price { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #C45C26; color: #FFFBF6; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9A4318; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C45C26; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Store nav
components.description: Sticky bone bar. Saffron appears only on the cart count pill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; background: #FFFBF6; border-bottom: 1px solid #E6DDD2; padding: 16px 24px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1A1714; } .ds-nav-mark { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; } .ds-nav-cart { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-count { background: #C45C26; color: #FFFBF6; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; min-width: 1.25rem; text-align: center; }

narrative.overview: A contemporary Cairo/Gulf gallery that also has a till. Shoppers browse a Route catalog in English and Arabic. Product photography does the selling; chrome recedes. Catalog and product pages Persuade; cart, checkout, auth, and orders Operate.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper canvas, ink text, one saffron action color
Product image is always the largest object on the card and the PDP
IBM Plex Sans + IBM Plex Sans Arabic as a single bilingual voice
Logical CSS and dir from locale; cart sheet opens from inline-end
Two rooms: warm paper (light) and espresso (dark)

rules.name: The One Spice Rule
rules.body: Saffron occupies ≤10% of any screen. Never a wash, hero background, or every nav link.

rules.name: The Two Rooms Rule
rules.body: Light is warm paper. Dark is espresso, not zinc. html.dark. Photos sit on bone.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a second display face or a different Arabic UI font.

rules.name: The Resting Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No drop shadows on product cards.

dos: Do set dir from locale and use logical CSS.
Do load IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic together.
Do keep saffron for primary actions and the cart badge only.
Do use next-intl with the ecommerce Arabic glossary.
donts: Don't use generic indigo/violet as primary.
Don't hardcode dir=ltr on the app shell.
Don't pair a Latin display serif with a different Arabic UI font.
Don't use cool gray/zinc dark themes, autoplay carousels, or stacked promo badges.
Don't leave product images on raw espresso — they sit on bone.
Don't mix ReUI Frame blocks with Card-surface blocks.
